sections.name: FieldSet
sections.title: Fieldset wrapper
sections.what: Builds the grouping wrapper for a set of related fields with vertical spacing between them.
sections.why: Likely reason: groups related fields and spaces them evenly.

sections.name: FieldLegend
sections.title: Legend heading
sections.what: Builds the heading text for a field set, with a size that changes based on its variant.
sections.why: Likely reason: names the group of fields for users and screen readers.

sections.name: FieldGroup
sections.title: Group wrapper and row layout styles
sections.what: Builds the group wrapper for stacked fields and defines the row layouts. Rows can stack vertically, sit side by side, or switch based on container width.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets one field row adapt to the space it has.

sections.name: Field
sections.title: Single field row
sections.what: Builds one field row that applies the chosen layout and marks itself as invalid when it has an error.
sections.why: Likely reason: the basic unit of a form, shared by every input.

sections.name: FieldContent
sections.title: Field content wrapper
sections.what: Builds the wrapper that holds the label and input inside a row, letting it grow to fill space.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the text and input together within the row.

sections.name: FieldLabel
sections.title: Field label
sections.what: Builds the label for a field, based on the shared label part, with a highlighted border and background when the field is checked.
sections.why: Likely reason: names the field and highlights selected choices.

sections.name: FieldTitle
sections.title: Field title as a heading
sections.what: Builds a plain title for a field that is not a form label, such as a group heading inside a choice.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives a heading without the label behavior.
sections.watch_out: It uses the same label attribute name as the field label, so styles or tests that target that name will match both.

sections.name: FieldDescription
sections.title: Helper description text
sections.what: Builds the smaller grey text that explains a field, with styled links.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives extra guidance under a field.

sections.name: FieldSeparator
sections.title: Divider with optional text
sections.what: Builds a horizontal line that can carry a short label in the middle, such as or.
sections.why: Likely reason: separates sections of a form, with an optional label.

sections.name: FieldError
sections.title: Error message display
sections.what: Shows an error message for a field. It shows one message as plain text, or a bulleted list when several errors exist. It shows nothing when no messages are available.
sections.why: Likely reason: makes validation problems visible and announced to screen readers.
sections.watch_out: An error without a message is skipped, so a problem can be hidden without any visible sign.

summary: Builds the pieces for laying out form fields: sets of fields, group headings, labels, descriptions, dividers, and error messages.
purpose: Gives every form in the app the same spacing, layout, and error display. Forms place these parts around their inputs.
why: Likely reason: a shared form layout keeps forms consistent and makes errors easy to see. The code does not state this directly.
how: It imports the label, divider, style helper, and a variant helper. It builds the groups, the single field row (which can stack vertically or sit side by side), the label, the title, the description, the divider with optional text, and the error display. The error display picks one message or lists several, and shows nothing when there are no errors. Everything is exported.
inputs: Children (inputs and text) placed inside the parts, an orientation setting for each row, a list of error objects, and standard element settings.
outputs: Layout components for forms. The error display is shown only when there is a message to show. Nothing is stored.
risks: The error display shows nothing if an error has no message, so a problem could go unseen. Layout styles change every form at once.
debug: If a field looks misaligned, check the orientation setting and the matching part here. If an error does not appear, check that a message is passed in. The error display is hidden when there is no content.
